summary: Synchrony Financial filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) under Rule 424(b)(5) for a proposed public offering of fixed-to-floating rate senior notes due 20--. The filing is a routine debt issuance by the issuer. The notes will be senior unsecured obligations, not listed, and not insured by the FDIC. Underwriters include J.P. Morgan, TD Securities, and Wells Fargo. The use of proceeds is not specified in the excerpt. This is an ordinary shelf takedown under an existing S-3 registration statement. No special-situation characteristics (e.g., acquisition, restructuring, tender offer) are present. Therefore, the filing is classified as 'None.'
